A '''third battle''' was fought on the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] between the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
In response to a third Separatist invasion of the planet, the Republic sent Clone Commando [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], also known as "Boss", to lead the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] forces stationed there.
The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ana Zett]] to oversee and assist in the campaign.

During the battle, the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] tested some of the newest [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] models they had developed at that time, such as the [[B2 Assault]] droid.<ref name="CWAF" />

Later in the campaign, a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] arrived on the planet to assist Republic forces. The Jedi completed tasks assigned to them by both Boss and [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carg]], weakening Separatist forces and hastening their eventual defeat by the Republic.<ref name="CWAF" />
